A number of lawmakers are frustrated after President Trump declined to implement sweeping

President Trump appears to be trying to lower the cost of energy, NPR Congressional reporter

Canada is mourning the loss of four service members who were killed during a fire at a
military base in Alberta.

Military officials say the fire broke out at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright late Saturday
afternoon and rapidly spread through the base.
Carney says what followed was one of the worst tragedies for the Canadian military in peacetime.

He says the soldiers training at the base are from the Princess Patricia's Canadian Light

They come from communities across the country and include members of the reserves and regular
force.

For NPR News, I'm Dan Carpenschuck in Toronto.
Hurricane Trudy has spared the Pacific Coast of Mexico not making landfall.
The Category 2 storm clock maximum sustained winds of more than 100 miles per hour.
Jack Bevin is a senior hurricane specialist with the National Hurricane Center.
He says Trudy is moving away from the coast to Baja, California.
For Baja, what's going to happen is that the hurricane is going to hit an area of very

Trudy's center is expected to remain near the Mexican coast through Sunday.

demonstrations across the country yesterday.

You're listening to NPR News from New York City.

From NPR News, it's all things considered.
I'm Noah Adams.
Noah Adams, a longtime host of all things considered, has died at age 84 after a long
illness.
And pure Scott Dutrow has this remembrance.
Adams hosted the show for 18 years across two stints, helping listeners process 9/11 and
the fall of the Berlin Wall, among other big stories.
But it was the quiet features where Adams left his mark.
Longtime All Things Considered host Melissa Block worked alongside him as a producer.
He was always observing, and he would have a little reporter's notebook, and he would

But somehow, when we came back, he would capture the character of a place or a person or a

Adams wrote books, too, including a memoir about learning to play piano in his 50s.
And he never stopped being a reporter.
His last piece for NPR aired just last month.
Scott Dutrow, NPR News, Washington.

Nicole Adrian and 35-year-old Nichols Schafer.
